object.attr: derived: otherwise the newest change by date can be on the side whose text the merge dropped; dates play no part (CF-T25). USAGE.md says the last change is the commit that git log -1 reports for the two files, which follows such a parent.
object.description: When a merge commit doesn't count as a change to the target, Mellon shall take the target's last change from the history of a parent whose target object file and figure equal the merge commit's.
